mechanism: Senna's stimulant laxative effect may reduce vedolizumab absorption and efficacy through accelerated GI transit, while vedolizumab's immunosuppressive action may alter gut flora that senna relies upon for activation.
action: Space dosing by 2+ hours and monitor vedolizumab therapeutic efficacy; consider alternative laxatives (polyethylene glycol) if chronic use needed in IBD patients.
